title: 第11章 到时候你就知道了第12章 掘坟
slug: 艾泽拉斯从掷骰子开始成神
lines: 旧城区兵营，艾伦三人在一名军官的带领下穿过重重岗哨。
指挥所内，长桌旁已经坐满了军官。
他们军装笔挺，神情严肃，面前的桌上铺着厚厚的卷宗和地图。
艾伦被引到桌旁次座落座，斯黛拉坐在他身侧，明显有些惶恐，小小的身体缩在椅子上，湛蓝色的大眼睛不安地左右张望，周围那些高大威严的军人让她像一只误入狮群的小老鼠。
温雷面无表情，一只手自然地搭在腰间，那里藏着他的匕首。
突然，所有军官齐刷刷站起身，动作整齐划一，靴跟碰撞发出清脆的声响。
他们挺直脊背，目光投向门口，右手抬起——
“第七军团，见过国——”
话音未落，一个身影大步跨入。
瓦里安·乌瑞恩像一只斗志昂扬的小狮子，昂首挺胸走进指挥所。
他今天穿着一身剪裁合体的深蓝色军装，领口绣着金色的狮头，腰间的佩剑剑鞘闪闪发亮。
他的目光扫过那些即将脱口而出的军官，眉头微微一皱，眼神中闪过一丝警告。
军官们硬生生憋回了想说的话，然后丝滑地转进：
“国……国家的雄鹰，暴风城的利刃，尊敬的马迪亚斯·肖尔少校！”
瓦里安嘴角微微上扬，对这个临时改口似乎颇为满意。
他在主位落座，目光扫过在场众人，在艾伦身上停顿了一瞬，微微颔首。
马迪亚斯·肖尔少校？
一直觉得“马迪亚斯”这个名字有些耳熟的温雷，微微侧身，凑到艾伦耳边，压低声音说：“我听过他。传闻他是暴风城阴影中的利刃，执掌着最残忍最无情、无处不在的特务机构——军情七处。”
他的声音很轻，却足以让一旁的斯黛拉听见。
“军情七处”四个字像一盆冰水兜头浇下，斯黛拉的小脸瞬间煞白。
她那双湛蓝的大眼睛，惊恐地看了看那个端坐的“肖尔少校”，然后，她悄无声息地将整个身体缩到艾伦身后，只露出一撮蓝色的头发在外面瑟瑟发抖。
艾伦强忍着笑意，明知故问地开口：“原来您就是肖尔少校？那您身边那位肖尔是？”
瓦里安还没来得及回答，真正的马迪亚斯·肖尔已经抢先开口：“我是肖尔少校的堂哥。”
他的语气平静，面不改色。
“噢——”艾伦将这个“噢”字的尾音拉得很长，瓦里安隐隐感觉对方在戏耍自己，却抓不住证据。
他轻咳一声，板起脸：“行了，先聊正事。”
一名军官应声起身，走到桌前的挂图旁，拿起一根细长的指示棒。
“诸位，”他清了清嗓子，指向地图上艾尔文森林的一处标记，“三周前，德·蒙莫朗西家族在其位于艾尔文森林伐木场附近的乡下别墅中，惨遭灭门。”
指示棒在图上点了点，那里标注着一座庄园的符号。
“根据现场勘察，死者共计十七人——德·蒙莫朗西家主夫妇、他们的五个孩子、七名仆从，以及三名恰好留宿的远亲。死因均为利器割喉，手法干净利落。”
军官一边说，瓦里安一边向身旁的艾伦透露更多内幕消息，
“由于德·蒙莫朗西家族在贵族圈中颇受排挤，所以这起惨案并未在贵族中引起太大波澜。暴风城官方只是草草将其定性为红巾盗贼流窜作案，毕竟别墅内的财物确实悉数失踪。”
红巾盗贼？
艾伦眉头一挑，脑海中浮现出温雷提过的“红头巾”，现在是黑暗之门开启后八年，暴风城还没完全重建完，石匠工会还没有因为欠薪而落草为寇，艾德温·范克里夫还没有创立迪菲亚兄弟会。
那这些红巾盗匪，又是从哪里冒出来的？
内幕当然不止瓦里安说的这些，当时，暴风城官方以‘剿灭艾尔文森林最大盗匪集团’、‘全面加强境内治安巡逻’的结果，将此事结案，没有掀起任何水花，德·蒙莫朗西家族就这样被历史的尘埃掩埋。

In the old city barracks, the three Allens passed through many sentries under the leadership of an officer.
In the command post, the long table was already filled with officers.
Their military uniforms were straight and their expressions were serious. The tables in front of them were covered with thick files and maps.
Allen was led to the table and sat down for the second time. Stella sat next to him, obviously a little frightened. Her small body huddled on the chair, her big blue eyes looked around uneasily. The tall and majestic soldiers around her made her look like a little mouse that had strayed into a pride of lions.
Wen Lei's face was expressionless, and one hand rested naturally on his waist, where his dagger was hidden.
Suddenly, all the officers stood up in unison, their movements uniform, and the heels of their boots colliding with each other made a crisp sound.
They straightened their backs, looked at the door, and raised their right hands——
"The Seventh Legion, I have seen the country——"
Before he finished speaking, a figure strode in.
Varian Wrynn walked into the command post with his head held high like a high-spirited lion cub.
Today he was wearing a well-tailored dark blue military uniform, with a golden lion's head embroidered on the collar, and a shining sword scabbard at his waist.
His eyes swept over the officers who were about to blurt out, his brows furrowed slightly, and a hint of warning flashed in his eyes.
The officers suppressed what they wanted to say, and then smoothly went on:
"The eagle of the country, the sharp blade of Stormwind City, the respected Major Mathias Shore!"
The corners of Varian's mouth rose slightly, and he seemed quite satisfied with this temporary change of words.
He sat down at the main seat, glanced at everyone present, paused for a moment on Allen, and nodded slightly.
Major Mathias Shore?
Wen Lei, who had always felt that the name "Madias" was familiar, leaned slightly to Allen's ear and lowered his voice and said, "I have heard of him. Rumor has it that he is the sharp blade in the shadow of Stormwind City, in charge of the most cruel, ruthless and ubiquitous spy agency - MI7."
His voice was very soft, but it was enough for Stella on the side to hear.
The words "MI7" were poured down like a basin of ice water, and Stella's little face turned pale instantly.
Her big blue eyes looked at the sitting "Major Shore" in horror. Then, she quietly shrank her whole body behind Allen, leaving only a bunch of blue hair trembling outside.
Allen suppressed a smile and spoke knowingly: "So you are Major Shore? Then who is the Shore next to you?"
Before Varian could answer, the real Mathias Shore had already spoken first: "I am Major Shore's cousin."
His tone was calm and his face remained calm.
"Oh -" Allen made the last sound of the word "oh" very long. Varian felt vaguely that the other party was playing tricks on him, but he couldn't find any evidence.
He coughed lightly and said with a straight face: "Okay, let's talk about business first."
An officer stood up in response, walked to the wall chart in front of the table, and picked up a slender indicator stick.
"Everyone," he cleared his throat and pointed to a mark in Elwynn Forest on the map, "Three weeks ago, the de Montmorency family was brutally murdered in their country house near the lumber camp in Elwynn Forest."
The indicator stick clicked on the map, where the symbol of a manor was marked.
"According to the on-site investigation, a total of seventeen people died - the de Montmorency family head and his wife, their five children, seven servants, and three distant relatives who happened to stay overnight. The cause of death was slit throats with a sharp weapon, and the technique was clean and neat."
As the officer spoke, Varian revealed more inside information to Allen beside him.
"Since the de Montmorency family is quite marginalized in the aristocratic circle, this tragedy did not cause much disturbance among the aristocracy. Stormwind City officials simply characterized it as a crime committed by red scarf thieves. After all, all the property in the villa was indeed missing."
Red scarf thief?
Allen raised his brows, and the "red hood" mentioned by Wen Lei came to mind. It was now eight years after the opening of the Dark Portal. Stormwind City had not yet been completely rebuilt, the Masons' Union had not yet turned into a gang due to unpaid wages, and Edwin VanCleef had not yet founded the Defias Brotherhood.
So where did these red scarf bandits come from?
Of course, there was more to the inside story than just what Varian said. At that time, Stormwind City officials closed the case with the results of "annihilating the largest bandit group in Elwynn Forest" and "comprehensively strengthening domestic security patrols" without causing any splash. The De Montmorency family was buried in the dust of history.
